verdict.rationale: Anrok's own pricing page says registration is "handled in every jurisdiction," and a product screen shows "automatic registration completion in 13 jurisdictions," so the vendor does handle registrations in-product with some completion visibility. Transparent per-registration pricing is not evidenced, and status tracking appears only in a dashboard image description. missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, documented per-registration status tracking, explicit state vs. local registration coverage, in-depth docs on the registration workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, registering for a sales tax permit is handled in-product — the vendor files state and local registrations on my behalf with transparent per-registration pricing and status tracking

citations.quote: grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates
